title: Premium Bonus and Vesting Schedule, Fixed Indexed Annuities
content:
**Bonus endorsement schedule — Ashgrove Fixed Indexed Annuities**

The premium bonus is credited to the contract value as a share of each premium received in the first contract year. The vesting schedule gives the vested share of the premium bonus for each contract year in order from contract year 1; after the listed years end, the bonus is fully vested.

### Premium bonus share

| Tier | Premium bonus |
|---|---|
| Ashgrove IndexEdge 5 | 0% (none) |
| Ashgrove IndexEdge 7 | 0% (none) |
| Ashgrove IndexEdge 10 | 0% (none) |
| Ashgrove IndexEdge 10 Bonus | 7% |
| Ashgrove IncomeShield 7 | 0% (none) |
| Ashgrove IncomeShield 10 | 0% (none) |

### Vested share of the premium bonus by contract year

| Contract year | Ashgrove IndexEdge 10 Bonus | Every other tier |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | 0% | 100% |
| 2 | 10% | fully vested |
| 3 | 20% | fully vested |
| 4 | 30% | fully vested |
| 5 | 40% | fully vested |
| 6 | 50% | fully vested |
| 7 | 60% | fully vested |
| 8 | 70% | fully vested |
| 9 | 80% | fully vested |
| 10 | 90% | fully vested |
| 11 and later | fully vested | fully vested |

The tiers other than the IndexEdge 10 Bonus pay no premium bonus; their schedule reads 100% vested from contract year 1.

### Unvested share, worked from the table

The unvested share for a contract year is one less the vested share for that year. On a hypothetical Ashgrove IndexEdge 10 Bonus contract:

| Contract year | Vested share | Unvested share | Hypothetical bonus credited of 3500 — unvested part |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | 0% | 100% | 3500.00 |
| 4 | 30% | 70% | 2450.00 |
| 10 | 90% | 10% | 350.00 |
| 11 | fully vested | 0% | 0.00 |

The bonus of 3500 in the example corresponds to a hypothetical first-year premium of 50000 at the 7% bonus share.
